test.command: cd backend && mvn test; cd frontend && npm test

blockingIssues.description: Transaction date formatting uses new Date(YYYY-MM-DD), which is timezone-sensitive and can render one day earlier/later for many users; this breaks user-visible date correctness on the Transactions page.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `commands.typecheck-frontend` to `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` to align validator behavior with frontend worker guidance and avoid piped output masking.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify TDD expectations for verification/audit-only features and require explicit deviation reporting when tests-first is intentionally skipped.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both categories-backend-api and categories-transactions-authorization reviews observed mismatch between strict tests-first wording and actual execution, while handoffs still marked procedure as fully followed.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a concise Spring Boot 4 + Jackson 3 test guidance note (ObjectMapper usage/config) to reduce avoidable setup confusion.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: categories-backend-api review captured explicit handoff feedback that Jackson 3.x differences caused test implementation churn.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document jsdom responsive-render caveat (multiple breakpoint branches can coexist in tests) and recommended query/assertion patterns.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: transactions-frontend-ui review found custom test helpers were needed because both mobile and desktop text nodes appeared during Vitest/jsdom runs.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a guidance check to keep generated feature expectedBehavior aligned with the actual API surface to avoid acceptance ambiguity.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: categories-transactions-authorization review noted expected behavior referenced GET-by-id checks that are not part of current category/transaction controller endpoints.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a frontend date-handling note for backend LocalDate strings: avoid `new Date(YYYY-MM-DD)` and format via timezone-safe parsing.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: transactions-frontend-ui review found a blocking timezone drift bug rooted in LocalDate parsing strategy.

rejectedObservations.observation: Document backend error payload fallback (`error` vs `message`) in shared library immediately.
Second report of strict backend tests-first mismatch.
